digo: Mvamva wa tsakani; Mphvamva tsaka (App. VI)

teaser.en: The forest double of a grassland shrub, though botanists put the two in different families.
teaser.sw: Pacha wa msituni wa kichaka cha nyikani, ingawa wataalamu wa mimea wamewaweka katika familia tofauti.

summary.en: Mvamva wa tsakani is Memecylon sansibaricum, a shrub or small tree of coastal forest. The Digo see it as the forest form of Mvamva, a Millettia of the bushed grassland.
summary.sw: Mvamva wa tsakani ni Memecylon sansibaricum, kichaka au mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani. Wadigo wanauona kama aina ya msituni ya Mvamva, Millettia ya nyika zenye vichaka.

about.en: Mvamva wa tsakani is an evergreen shrub or small tree with opposite, leathery, glossy leaves whose side veins are almost invisible. Like other Memecylons it bears clusters of small blue to purple flowers on the older twigs, followed by small round berries that ripen dark purple or black.
about.sw: Mvamva wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani yanayokabiliana, magumu kama ngozi na yanayong'aa, ambayo mishipa yake ya pembeni karibu haionekani. Kama Memecylon nyingine, huzaa vishada vya maua madogo ya buluu hadi zambarau kwenye vitawi vikongwe, yakifuatwa na beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva zikawa za zambarau iliyokolea au nyeusi.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: The name shows how Digo naming pairs plants by habitat: a forest plant is named after a look-alike from the open country and marked tsaka or wa tsakani, 'of the forest'.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaonyesha jinsi utaratibu wa kutoa majina wa Kidigo unavyooanisha mimea kwa makazi: mmea wa msituni hupewa jina la mmea unaofanana nao wa maeneo ya wazi na kutiwa alama tsaka au wa tsakani, 'wa msituni'.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mvamva wa tsakani; Appendix VI writes it Mphvamva tsaka and explains it as 'forest Millettia', the forest type of Mphamva (Millettia usaramensis), which grows in bushed grassland. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Memecylon sansibaricum.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mvamva wa tsakani; Kiambatisho VI kinaliandika Mphvamva tsaka na kulifafanua kuwa 'Millettia ya msituni', aina ya msituni ya Mphamva (Millettia usaramensis), unaoota katika nyika zenye vichaka. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Memecylon sansibaricum.

reason.en: The grassland Mvamva it is named after
reason.sw: Mvamva wa nyikani ambao umepewa jina lake
